d:
In the streets of Patna, food carries a different rhythm. In this episode of Khana Dil Se, Hansal Mehta steps into a simple courtyard kitchen to revive a traditional recipe that has quietly lived on for generations.
Bihari style Mutton Curry. Slow-cooked. Deep. Robust. Made the way it was always meant to be made.
In eastern India, mutton was once sealed in earthen pots and cooked over a steady flame. The utensils have changed. The taste has not.
Served with fresh hot rice and Aloo Chokha, this meal will feel like home.
INGREDIENTS LIST
For the Mutton Marinade:
• Mutton (as required)
